description:
Root-cause spike complete. The dirty retry prototype is not a landing candidate: it reconstructs callable and carrier authority downstream, which is why the continuation symptom remains.

Output contract
A first-class callable value has one immutable construction-owned runtime boundary. It carries the producer's actual semantic captures and physical capture slots, its resolved member set, a uniform boxed closure-call ABI, and a uniform boxed return seam. Member-specific dispatch, target ABI decoding, and return reconstruction occur only inside that boundary. A DispatchSet/callable-wide inventory remains analysis only.

First losses
1. Backend packaging rediscovers a local FunctionRef/Lambda through CallableId, expands callable-wide members, and invents capture ordinal -> target-input-prefix mappings. This discards the producer-correlated CallableFlowFact already used by transport.
2. ShapeDescr::Nothing is structural payload width zero, not semantic absence. BackendInputLayout publishes only width, then finalize_carrier_layouts scans later consumers to reconstruct selected ValueRef carriers. It misses continuation paths and mutates ABI after construction.
3. BackendCallableCapture.transport_slot conflates a logical transport position with a physical runtime slot: Nothing has a position but no lane; native reads Some as physical presence.
4. The native/codegen surface reselects members.first() after wrapper construction, reintroducing an arbitrary target ABI for heterogeneous members.

Required model
Publish the construction boundary from the producer flow and transport facts before backend/native lowering:
- semantic capture roles and explicit physical capture-slot presence;
- member-specific target semantic-role mapping, target input layout, predicates, and return topology;
- per-semantic-input transport mode: Structural(width may be zero) or RuntimeCarrier(ValueRef), decided by producer/edge/entry-capture presence facts, never a backend/native use-site scan;
- boundary-level physical ABI only: explicit capture refs, one boxed ValueRef per source call input, boxed return.

Delete rather than compensate
Remove post-hoc finalize_carrier_layouts consumer scans, construction/ingress rediscovery as ABI authority, transport_slot-as-presence, and legacy singleton member ABI fields. BackendCallableEntry becomes resolution inventory; the construction-owned member record owns adaptation.

Proof
Use fixtures2/00181_enum_reduce_operator_ref.fz plus enum_predicate_search, enum_take_drop_split, range-reduce scalar, and a heterogeneous-member construction test. Assert production artifacts expose the construction boundary and carrier modes; run interpreter and JIT paths. Lazy sid22 descriptor tagging is confirmed correct and is not the first loss.
title: fz-k22: shared consumer bodies must dispatch closure calls through the VALUE-carried entry identity -- a static position->entry stamp is unrepresentable for type-variable arg slots
